title: Rethinking how we Scaffold AI Agents - Rahul Sengottuvelu, Ramp
talk_summary: Speaker argues to prefer systems that improve with more compute, illustrated by an arbitrary-CSV agent that runs many parallel LLM+code-interpreter attempts against a verifier. He also demos an LLM-as-backend email client that is slow and barely works, suggesting the pattern is directional rather than production-ready.

takeaways.what_they_do: For arbitrary CSV conversion, they give the model a code interpreter and a unit test/verifier, run many attempts in parallel, and keep a passing output.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you run it 50 times in parallel it's actually very likely that it works really well
takeaways.numbers: 50 parallel attempts; ~10,000x more compute than deterministic approach; <$1 per task

takeaways.what_they_do: They include a unit test/verifier in the prompt so the agent can check its own output before returning.
takeaways.evidence_quote: here's a unit test here's a verifier that you can use to tell if it's working or not

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of hand-coding parsers or only classifying columns, let the model write and run pandas/Python against CSV samples to produce the target format.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you have a code interpreter so you can write whatever code you want

takeaways.what_they_do: They accept much more inference compute for a task because engineer time and failed conversions cost more than sub-dollar model calls.
takeaways.evidence_quote: what is truly scarce in the world is engineer time

takeaways.technique: LLM chooses when to call deterministic code
takeaways.what_they_do: In the third architecture, the LLM controls flow and drops into classical code/tools only when needed, rather than a fixed script calling the LLM at one step.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it decides to break in into this classical land when it needs to

takeaways.technique: Keep LLM out of latency-critical request path
takeaways.what_they_do: Their demo makes the LLM simulate a Gmail UI per click; it is very slow and barely works.
takeaways.evidence_quote: this kind of software barely works today
